row.title: SEED-ADMIT-1: seeds are admitted by the year simulation before they count as launched
row.body: Added foundation/seedadmit.py, seed/scripts/seedadmit.py, seed/autonomy/kit.json and seed/autonomy-kit/autonomy.workflow.yml. The generator wires the kit and runs the year simulation on the new system; held seeds are not launched. Onboarding the reference manifest found and fixed four seed defects (sweeper gh helper regression, seed yearsim crash, missing analytics and standards kernel paths, platform-coupled imports); verified by the onboarding probe: instances/second-tenant admitted, p10 730 days, strict p10 730, 452 worker tests pass. Residual risk: the live Cloudflare deploy of a generated system is done by its own bootstrap.yml on first push and is not yet observed from this session.
